verdicts.reason: A: a ~100px dead gap sits between the tiny phone and the text, and SOLSTICE floats off-axis up and to the left of the headline. The badges are as large as the CTA and stacked in a grid with it, so the CTA doesn't stand out, and about 180px on the right is empty while the middle is cramped. B reads cleanly left to right (phone, then brand/headline/subline on one left edge, then badges, then the CTA at the end) with a clear hierarchy, but the phone circle touches the top and bottom edges, the CTA is jammed against the right edge, and the stacked badges are oversized and compete with the CTA.
